title: Give the King One Square
setup: Black's king is on a3 with a single pawn on b4, and your king on c2 is already doing half the work.
hint: Your king covers more than it looks. Work out which square Black would go to and be there first.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qc4}} is not check, but it takes b3 and b4 while your king holds b2. Only {{Ka4}} keeps the king off your edge — {{b3+}} runs into {{Qxb3#}}, and {{Qa6#}} lands. A king on the edge with one square left is already mated — it just does not know yet.
